value.source_gap: FA-P1/aggregate-stratify asks that missing or confounded comparisons be documented before assigning a cause. U63234b7d85/D1 instead says missing comparisons or confounding prevent attribution, introducing a categorical attribution prohibition not supplied by the source.

resolutions.reason: FA-P1/aggregate-stratify.probe requires documentation before attribution; its uncertainty states concealed request mix and no currently established attribution. U63234b7d85/D1.uncertainty adds the universal prevention gate. This is newly introduced strengthening, rather than an inherited raw fit conflict or a labelled proposal. The source provides comparative targets; it does not state that every missing comparison blocks any attribution. No other addition is adjudicated.

FA-P1/aggregate-stratify.causal_relation explicitly compares persistence at similar load across releases against persistence within a release across load bands. Uc117b56e82/D1.claim names stratification by deployment interval and load but does not retain the within-release persistence comparison or that explicit contrast. Its release/load predictions do not supply the omitted comparison operation. The retained lineage to D1 asserts preservation without restoring the missing relation.

FA-P1/aggregate-stratify.discriminator gives release shifts at comparable load, similar load relationships across releases for the load account, and neither-pattern non-defeat. Uc117b56e82/D1.discriminator preserves both predictions and says either pattern remains informative. D1.probe also retains existing-strata inspection and documentation of missing or confounded comparisons before assigning a cause. The separate within-release comparison omission belongs to the source causal_relation, resolved at index 1; it does not erase these fully stated discriminator/probe conditions.

Uc117b56e82/D1 omits the explicit within-release persistence comparison from FA-P1/aggregate-stratify.causal_relation, as resolved at index 1. Consequently not every protected source field is retained, despite retained discriminator/probe conditions and the agreed uncertainty, lineage and fit scalars.

FH-P2/fixed-press.discriminator says the press might still chip and that absence of impacts does not establish safety. U07dfba80e2/fixed-press rejected lineage, target_ids=[], says No impacts proves no safety, with cracking unresolved. That phrase can mean either absence of impacts provides no safety proof, which preserves the limitation, or absence of impacts proves unsafety, which changes it. The surrounding unresolved cracking language favors the former but does not settle the wording. Rejection and absent targets do not themselves establish loss; this safety limitation remains genuinely ambiguous.

FH-P2/fixed-press source relation, hand-held violation, surrogate-study limitation and unresolved cracking/load/precision appear in U07dfba80e2/fixed-press rejected lineage with target_ids=[]. Full protected-field retention additionally requires the source absence-of-impacts safety limitation. Its ambiguous rendering is unresolved at index 4, so neither complete preservation nor a definite semantic loss can be established without forcing a reading.
